description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that has flying due to Combine Chrysalis.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
You may sacrifice the Eldrazi Spawns to get infinite {C}, if desired.
